evals.name: bookmarks-screen
evals.prompt: Add a Bookmarks tab to our Expo app (Expo Router, TypeScript, TanStack Query, en+es dictionaries). It lists saved posts from `GET /me/bookmarks` -> `{ items: [{ id, title, author, savedAt }] }`, newest first, with loading, empty and error states and pull-to-refresh; tapping one opens `/post/[id]`. Write the files you'd add or change (stub what you assume exists) and the tests.
evals.expected_output: A thin route file in app/(app)/ rendering the feature screen; features/bookmarks with lib/ (Zod-parsed fetch, routes.ts hrefs, query key factory), a useQuery hook, presentational components that never fetch, FlashList with a memoised item, tokens via the theme and shared/ui primitives, copy in both dictionaries, kebab-case files, a feature_readme.md, component tests through MSW and a Maestro flow.
expectations: The route file under app/ only renders the feature's screen
The fetch lives in features/bookmarks/lib and the response is parsed with Zod
Data is read through a TanStack Query hook with a key from a key factory
No component or screen calls fetch directly
The post href comes from a routes helper, not string concatenation in the component
The list uses FlashList with a memoised item component
Styling uses theme tokens / shared/ui primitives, no raw hex or magic numbers in the feature
Copy is added to both en and es dictionaries
Every new file name is kebab-case (Expo Router reserved names excepted)
A feature_readme.md is included
Tests: component tests through MSW, and a Maestro flow

evals.name: review-planted-violations
evals.prompt: Review this Expo PR (files/review.diff) and list what we must fix before merging.
evals.expected_output: Flags: route file fetching and holding layout, fetch in useEffect, unparsed `as Post[]`, token in AsyncStorage, inline style hex, string-built href, Platform.OS branch in a feature, string literal copy, sleep in Maestro, FlatList with an inline renderItem capturing state.
expectations: Flags the route file fetching data and holding layout (should only render the feature screen)
Flags fetch inside useEffect (use a TanStack Query hook over lib/)
Flags `as Post[]` without runtime validation (parse with Zod)
Flags the token read from AsyncStorage (use expo-secure-store via the session store)
Flags inline style objects with raw hex/numbers instead of theme tokens
Flags the string-built href '/post/' + id (use a routes helper)
Flags Platform.OS branching inside a feature component
Flags hard-coded copy instead of dictionary strings
Flags sleep: 3000 in the Maestro flow (use extendedWaitUntil)
Flags FlatList with an inline renderItem capturing state (FlashList + memoised item)
